articles.title: Latin America’s biggest stock exchange now offers options on bitcoin, ether and solana futures
articles.snippet: These options settle into underlying futures contracts rather than spot cryptoassets, involving no custody, transfer, or administration of tokens.

articles.title: Sony secures conditional approval to set up U.S. stablecoin trust bank
articles.snippet: The New York-based subsidiary, fully owned by Sony Bank, will be capitalized with $40 million to support its upcoming stablecoin business operations.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin rises to $63,000, oil and bond yields drop as markets look past latest Iran dustup
articles.snippet: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost a net $84 million on Wednesday, ending a three-day inflow run that had pulled in roughly $509 million

articles.title: Polymarket bets on U.S. marketing blitz to win back trust after 4-year ban: Report
articles.snippet: The prediction market's head of U.S. operations says the business is taking steps to legitimize itself after years of legal scrutiny.

articles.title: UK politicians mull permanent crypto donation ban in wake of Nigel Farage scandal
articles.snippet: Labour lawmakers proposed a full moratorium on crypto donations in March, which some have sought be made permanent after millions of dollars in contributions were linked to Reform leader Nigel Farage.
